items.title: You Just Went Back Before Kyoto
items.hook: Nara held the capital before Kyoto did.
items.task: Find one thing that feels older than Gion: a hall, a statue, a tree.
items.reveal: The capital sat here first. Then it moved.
items.notes: Confirm the Nara-period dating before live.

items.title: Why Are There Deer Everywhere?
items.task: Watch the deer. Why would a city let them walk the park?
items.reveal: They are treated as messengers of Kasuga. Sacred status is cultural, not a zoo rule.

items.title: Do Deer Really Bow?
items.task: Watch several deer, not one. Do they bow without food?
items.reveal: A dip of the head is often a learned ask for biscuits, not a court bow.
items.notes: Do not claim a magical bow. Replaces the old idea script-deer-bow.

items.title: Deer Rules
items.task: Read the park rules. Wild animals. No teasing. Shika senbei only. Show empty hands when you are done.
items.reveal: They bite and knock. Treat them as wild.
